verdict.rationale: Docs reference a CLI/test runner ('run API tests', 'hopp test' generating JUnit reports) and pre-request scripting snippets, implying a testing/scripting layer exists, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents writing assertions against response status, body, or headers (e.g., a pw.expect/test-script API). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of assertion syntax for status/body/headers, and independent/hands-on confirmation that such assertions run successfully.
